text: There are 18 professors, 16 associate professors, 4 doctoral supervisors, 31 master's supervisors, 37 doctors, 1 selected into the National Millions of Talents Project, 1 Minister of Education Jiang Scholar, 1 Zhejiang "10,000 Talents Plan", 1 Zhejiang "Thousand Talents Plan", and 1 chief expert of Zhejiang Industrial Electrical Industry Cluster. The existing national and local joint engineering laboratory of electrical digital design technology, Zhejiang Provincial Engineering Laboratory of electrical digital design technology, mechanical engineering user-side photovoltaic microgrid engineering research center, Zhejiang Province Key Laboratory of Low-voltage Electrical Intelligent Technology, Zhejiang Province Low-voltage Electrical Appliance Technology Innovation Service Platform, Zhejiang Province Low-voltage Electrical Appliance Industry Technology Innovation Strategic Alliance, Zhejiang Province Key Science and Technology Innovation Team of Low-voltage Electrical Appliance Technology for Smart Grid, Zhejiang Province Coastal Engineering Special Power Supply Technology Innovation Team, Zhejiang Province Key Discipline of Universities, The most important disciplines and characteristic majors of the school. It has characteristics in special power supply, smart appliances, microgrid and other aspects. In recent years, he has presided over more than 40 major national science and technology projects, national development and reform commission projects, national natural science foundation of China and provincial major science and technology projects. He has won 1 first prize and 1 second prize of Science and Technology Progress Award of the Ministry of Education, 4 provincial and ministerial scientific research awards such as the First Prize of the Scientific Research Outstanding Achievement Award of Colleges and Universities, and the Zhejiang Science and Technology Progress Award, published more than 60 papers in important journals at home and abroad, more than 30 papers included in SCI and EI, and authorized more than 30 Chinese invention patents and more than 40 utility patents.
